title: Shifts in the jet stream are behind Europe's long heatwaves | New Scientist
description: Two types of jet stream patterns seem to be causing persistent heat domes over Europe, with big questions for the future
author: Alec Luhn

title: Game that reduces dementia risk may clear amyloid from men's brains | New Scientist
description: Playing a mental speed-training game seems to help the brain clear a protein linked to Alzheimer’s disease in men, but may work in women through different mechanisms
author: Carissa Wong

title: Four children with terminal brain cancer saved by new cell therapy | New Scientist
description: An experimental immunotherapy has beaten aggressive brain tumours in a handful of children, and a personalised version is now being tested on more patients
author: Alice Klein

title: UN space database aimed at easing global tensions is mysteriously down | New Scientist
description: A list of global space launches designed to calm cold war tensions and promote transparency has been missing from the UN's website for months
author: Matthew Sparkes

title: Global warming already causing crop losses of over $20 billion a year | New Scientist
description: Climate change is already having a big impact on crop yields, and the subsequent financial losses will continue to rise as the world keeps warming
author: Michael Le Page

title: Mathematicians put AI to work on Fermat's last theorem | New Scientist
description: At an event in London, mathematicians have made unexpectedly fast progress on formalising Fermat's last theorem using AI
author: Matthew Sparkes
